title: PlanRequest
description: What a planner is given: the requirements, the design whole, the practices held by a plan, and when it answers a challenge, the plan it wrote and the findings.

file.description: The requirements file, relative to the project, as the design names it and requirements.check accepted it.

requirements.description: The requirements file whole, as requirements.check accepted it.

design.description: The design file the plan is cut from.

document.description: The design file whole, as the design workflow committed it: its modules, and its interfaces with each action's schema files, the conditions it serves and its worked examples.

practices.description: The practices held by a plan, from the practices files on the integration branch, each its id and its words.

plan.description: A plan as schemas/plan.json gives it.

id.description: The practice's id, such as P-33.

answer.description: Whether the plan holds the practice.

sentence.description: Why, in one sentence; for not-held, the slice and where the plan breaks it.

practices.description: The first challenge's answers of not-held, each with its sentence.

findings.description: What the challenger asks the planner to correct, one sentence each, naming the slice and what to change.

answering.description: Only when the planner answers a challenge, once: its first plan, each practice the challenger answered not held and the challenger's findings.
